<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that converts an aromatic ketone (e.g., acetophenone) back to an aryl halide and an acyl chloride via Friedel‑Crafts acylation. Using the functional‑group names from the catalog, the forward reaction breaks an aryl halide and forms a ketone, creating a new aromatic C–C bond (6‑6). We'll search the template catalog for templates matching these criteria on the product SMILES “CC(=O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
